effect_description_eng: [Main] You may play 1 blue [Renamon] or [Valner Dragnogh] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area. [End of Your Turn] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect.) ・Choose 1 of your blue [ALYSION] trait Digimon and it attacks 1 of your opponent's Digimon with fewer digivolution cards than it. It can also attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with this effect.
